name: czrecoil_frame_update_fullscreen_cmd_ui
description: CZRecoilFrame::OnUpdateFullscreenCmdUI removes the fullscreen menu command.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4318e0 yet; the handler currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4318e0 validates RemoveMenu(pCmdUI->m_menu->m_hMenu, 0x9c4e, MF_BYCOMMAND).
The native smoke attaches a temporary HMENU to the command UI proxy and verifies the fullscreen command is removed.
